description: Client-driven consensus loop where YOU (the host model) are the arbiter, one action per call: init (returns sessionId + blind prompt) -> record_blind (your pre-commit verdict) -> dispatch_peers (server fans out to the providers) -> submit_adjudication (your verdict + per-issue accept/dismiss/defer) -> submit_revision (your revised plan), looping until converged or consensus.maxRounds rounds (default 5). Only the dispatch_peers action calls external providers; the others are local transitions on the ephemeral per-session loop store (keyed by sessionId, lost on server restart). Each call returns a text-wrapped JSON envelope with the next status/round (plus blindPrompt, opinions[], or finalReport by action). Advisory to the outside world, but mutates server loop state on every call.

action.description: Which loop step to run this call, in order: init -> record_blind -> dispatch_peers -> submit_adjudication -> submit_revision.

blindVerdict.description: record_blind only: your pre-commit verdict text, written before the panel is revealed.

cwd.description: dispatch_peers only: working directory the peer providers run in.

decisions.description: submit_adjudication only: per-issue rulings, each { source, category, description, action: accept|dismiss|defer, reason }; dismiss/defer require a reason.

diffSummary.description: submit_revision only: one line summarizing what changed.

expert.description: init only: optional persona for the peer panel (see the expert tools).

prompt.description: init only: the plan/proposal under review.

revisedPlan.description: submit_revision only: the full revised plan addressing accepted issues.

sessionId.description: Loop id returned by init; required on every action except init.

verdict.description: submit_adjudication only: your adjudicated verdict after weighing the panel.

name: consensus-step
